name: garmin-owl
description: Local-only, read-only access to your Garmin Connect health and activity data.
long_description: Garmin Owl runs entirely as a local stdio MCP server. It reads your existing Garmin Connect data on demand through the unofficial python-garminconnect client. It has no write tools, public listener, telemetry, analytics, remote database, or bundled credentials. Garmin session tokens remain in the standard local ~/.garminconnect store.

tools.name: get_daily_summary
tools.description: Read a concise Garmin daily summary.

tools.name: get_hrv
tools.description: Read Garmin HRV status and nightly values.

tools.name: get_recovery
tools.description: Read a combined summary of Garmin-provided recovery metrics, with a reason for each absent component and no derived score.

tools.name: get_training_readiness
tools.description: Read Garmin training readiness and available components.

tools.name: get_body_battery
tools.description: Read Garmin Body Battery charged/drained and levels, plus an optional capped time series.

tools.name: get_stress
tools.description: Read Garmin average/max stress and per-band durations, plus an optional capped time series.

tools.name: get_activities
tools.description: Read a concise list of Garmin activities in a date range, defaulting to the last 14 days.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Read details for one Garmin activity without location tracks or raw streams.

tools.name: get_body_composition
tools.description: Read Garmin weight and body-composition data.

tools.name: get_training_context
tools.description: Read recovery and preceding training anchored to a requested date, with transparent comparisons.

tools.name: get_recovery_trend
tools.description: Trend sleep, HRV (nightly and weekly), resting HR, readiness, and Body Battery across 7, 14, or 28 preceding Garmin days.

tools.name: get_training_week
tools.description: Summarize one Mon-Sun training week, with per-metric activity coverage for every total.

tools.name: get_training_load
tools.description: Read Garmin training load/status aggregates, naming any source Garmin had no data for.

tools.name: get_training_zones
tools.description: Read configured Garmin heart-rate and cycling power-zone thresholds.

tools.name: get_running_tolerance
tools.description: Read Garmin running distance, biomechanical impact load, tolerance, and feedback for a bounded date range.

tools.name: get_recent_activities
tools.description: Read bounded, optionally type-filtered recent activities.

tools.name: compare_activities
tools.description: Compare 2-10 activities using concise normalized metrics, disclosing how many reported each one.

tools.name: get_cycle
tools.description: Read normalized cycle phase and timing without notes, symptoms, or raw daily logs.
